message: Generated from Stimulation_2emg.hex Debug build on 2026-07-05. Firmware exposes independent ADC2 PPG and ADC3 noise sampling controls. ADC2 PPG frames now drive the selected LED pulse directly: each frame takes an LEDs-off ambient sample, turns the selected LED on, samples ADC2 at the end of the configured LED-on pulse, then turns LEDs off for the rest of the frame. ADC3RATE still controls ADC3 noise decimation from the 1 ms SAADC base tick.
